page.layout: One blank leaf, no printed text. Faded handwritten name-strokes and ink smears across the upper half, a dark mark at the top right, and a torn or bound edge along the right side.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The upper half carries faded manuscript ownership inscriptions (apparently a name and a date in cursive). These are handwriting, not print, and are not transcribed. Brown stains, ink smears and a dark mark sit at the top right. Torn or damaged paper runs along the right edge, and there are a few spots on the left.
